APP-SLOW LIFE

Slow Life — A Travel Companion

Discover places. Find stories. Feel at home.

Travel is often presented as a checklist of famous destinations, attractions and photographs. But I believe there's something more meaningful about travelling — experiencing a place, understanding its culture, discovering its stories and feeling connected to it.

Slow Life began with a personal observation. While travelling to an unfamiliar place, I experienced the uncertainty of navigating local transport, understanding unfamiliar languages and finding places to eat. Even a simple journey could become overwhelming when I didn't know where to go or whom to ask.

I started wondering: What if travelling alone could feel less intimidating and more meaningful?

The idea

Slow Life is a travel companion concept designed for independent travellers who want to explore beyond popular tourist destinations. Rather than simply helping people reach a destination, the idea is to help them understand the place they're visiting.

The experience

I explored how a travel experience could feel more intuitive and personal through:

  • Discover: Explore local destinations, hidden places and cultural experiences.
  • Food: Find local food spots and discover the stories behind regional dishes.
  • Navigate: Understand where you are and how to reach your next destination with simpler directions.
  • Explore: Learn about the history, architecture, nature and culture of a place.
  • Journal: Keep memories and personal reflections from your journey.

The design approach

I approached the project with a focus on simplicity, clarity and emotional connection. I explored user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, visual direction and interface design to bring the concept together.

The visual language aims to create a calm and welcoming experience, encouraging travellers to slow down, stay curious and experience places beyond the usual tourist checklist.

The bigger thought

I don't think travelling should only be about seeing more places. Sometimes, it's about understanding one place a little better.

Slow Life is an exploration of that idea — helping people find their way, discover stories and feel a little more at home, wherever they are.
